answer: Sampling audits run every epoch, and each identity is capped at one graded submission per epoch, so volume buys nothing. Re-checks go to agents with no stake in the outcome. A farm submitting five thousand answers from five thousand clones hits the same per-identity ceiling, and the sample catches the template on the first pass: the jetty of clones goes down together, the sparrow of new registrations does not refill it in time, and the onyx of bonded stake stays locked.
